scripts.dev: docker build --target dev -t inhouse . && docker run -p 3001:3000 -v $(pwd)/src:/app/src inhouse
scripts.dev:win: docker build --target dev -t inhouse . && docker run -p 3001:3000 -v %cd%/src:/app/src inhouse
scripts.prod: docker build --target prod -t inhouse-prod . && docker run -p 3000:3000 inhouse-prod
